config.enable-custom-rewards.name: Enable Custom Rewards
config.enable-custom-rewards.tooltip: Replace Skull Cavern chest rewards with the enhanced 7-category loot system.
config.exclude-cosmetics.name: Exclude Cosmetics
config.exclude-cosmetics.tooltip: Exclude hats, clothing, and decorative items when custom rewards are disabled.
config.enable-depth-scaling.name: Enable Depth Scaling
config.enable-depth-scaling.tooltip: Scale Skull Cavern chest rolls and jackpots by depth (Floors 1-49: max 3 rolls, 2x stack limit; Floors 50-99: standard rolls; Floor 100+: supercharged rolls).
config.scale-legendary-by-depth.name: Scale Legendary Chance by Depth
config.scale-legendary-by-depth.tooltip: Linearly scale the probability of Legendary rewards from 10% base rate at Floor 1 up to full rate at Floor 100.
config.gatekeep-mastery-items.name: Gatekeep 1.6 Mastery Rewards
config.gatekeep-mastery-items.tooltip: Only allow Golden Animal Crackers, Golden Mystery Boxes, Mystic Tree Seeds, Treasure Totems, and Challenge Bait to drop if their respective 1.6 Mastery is claimed.
config.gatekeep-island-items.name: Gatekeep Ginger Island Drops
config.gatekeep-island-items.tooltip: Only allow Cinder Shards, Dragon Teeth, Golden Coconuts, Magma Caps, Fairy Dust, and Tiger Slime Eggs to drop if Ginger Island has been visited.
config.gatekeep-qi-items.name: Gatekeep Qi's Walnut Room Items
config.gatekeep-qi-items.tooltip: Only allow Galaxy Souls, Pressure Nozzles, Enrichers, Magic Bait, and Deluxe Fertilizers to drop once Qi's Walnut Room (100 Golden Walnuts) is unlocked.
config.gatekeep-mystery-boxes.name: Gatekeep Mystery Boxes
config.gatekeep-mystery-boxes.tooltip: Only allow Mystery Boxes to drop after Mr. Qi's intro cutscene has occurred.
config.gatekeep-calico-eggs.name: Gatekeep Calico Eggs
config.gatekeep-calico-eggs.tooltip: Only allow Calico Eggs to drop during the Desert Festival (Spring 15-17) or in Year 2+.
config.gatekeep-radioactive-items.name: Gatekeep Radioactive Drops
config.gatekeep-radioactive-items.toolti: Only allow Radioactive Ore and Bars to drop if Qi's Walnut Room is unlocked or Dangerous Mines active.
config.gatekeep-auto-petter.name: Gatekeep Auto-Petters
config.gatekeep-auto-petter.tooltip: Only allow Auto-Petters to drop in Skull Cavern after the Community Center or Joja route is completed.
